pwa.offlineBody: Study features need a network connection. You can retry when you're back online.
pwa.offlinePrerequisite: Visit QuizFree online at least once so the offline shell can be installed.
pwa.updateReloadWarning: Reloading may lose in-progress study answers.
pwa.studyNeedsNetwork: Learning and sync require connectivity in this version.
pwa.installIosHint: On iPhone/iPad: Share → Add to Home Screen to install QuizFree.
pwa.syncFailedSessionComplete: Session completion could not be synced. Sync now or keep studying — your progress is saved on this device.
